c5304404805968bc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة سهم الهلال للمقاولات العامة عن مهندس إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة الحدود الشمالية. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية وضع وتنفيذ خطط المشاريع المتكاملة، وإدارة التكاليف والموارد، وضمان سير العمل وفق الجداول الزمنية المحددة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. الهدف من الوظيفة يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف على جميع جوانب تخطيط المشاريع وتنفيذها ومراقبتها، مع التركيز على تحديد النطاق الدقيق، وإعداد الجداول الزمنية، وإدارة الموارد والتكاليف بفعالية. كما يضمن الدور التواصل الفعال وتوزيع المعلومات حول حالة تقدم المشروع لجميع الأطراف المعنية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية وضع وتنفيذ خطة متكاملة للمشروع، والتحكم في التغييرات، وتحديد نطاق المشروع بدقة من حيث البنود والأزمنة، مع التعرف على الجوانب الفنية المحددة لتنفيذ العمل. تقدير الأوقات والمواعيد النهائية للمشروع، وإعداد الجداول الزمنية باستخدام البرامج والتطبيقات المتخصصة، وتحديد المهام المجدولة وفترات تنفيذها والموارد المتاحة لكل منها. إدارة التكلفة والموارد المطلوبة لإنجاز المشروع، بما في ذلك تخطيط وإدارة الموارد البشرية والمادية والمعدات والتقنيين، وتقدير التكلفة المتوقعة بالتعاون مع مهندسي التكاليف والمهندسين المعنيين بالتنفيذ، ومتابعة الإنفاق. إعداد وتطبيق خطة علاقات مع جميع الأطراف ذات الصلة بالمشروع، وتوفير أساس لتوزيع المعلومات ونشر حالة مراحل المشروع. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال إدارة المشاريع الهندسية. إتقان استخدام برامج وتطبيقات إعداد الجداول الزمنية وإدارة المشاريع. القدرة على تحديد نطاق المشاريع بدقة وإدارة التغييرات بفعالية. مهارات ممتازة في التخطيط، التنظيم، وإدارة الموارد والتكاليف. بيئة العمل يعمل مهندس إدارة المشاريع بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مؤسسة سهم الهلال للمقاولات العامة في منطقة الحدود الشمالية، ويكون جزءاً أساسياً من الجهود المبذولة لضمان نجاح المشاريع وتنفيذها بكفاءة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

c5a7e4c331edb307.description: About the Role Acwa China is seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer to join their team in Al Khafji, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves planning and supervising all maintenance activities for electrical equipment within the plant, working under the direction of the Section Head. The role requires 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Assign preventive and corrective maintenance jobs as directed by the Section Head. Supervise and coordinate the activities of maintenance staff. Maintain records, prepare reports, and compose correspondence related to work. Execute work orders through CMMS (SAP) and coordinate with the planning engineer for job completion and technical matters. Ensure necessary communications and relations are maintained to report on status and ensure corrective actions are undertaken. Assist the Maintenance Manager in executing corrective and planned maintenance in line with the annual scheduled maintenance plan. Perform technical evaluation of quotations from the purchase department and recommend appropriate choices. Prepare purchase requisitions for spare parts and consumables, ensuring budgetary constraints and strategic spares availability. Review and recommend new maintenance procedures and work instructions. Supervise, direct, and coordinate the activities of all personnel assigned to the area. Ensure Environmental Aspect-Impact and Hazard Risk Assessments are carried out, controlled, and updated. Implement, monitor, and report IMS objectives, targets, and programs. Provide necessary resources for effective implementation and sustenance of IMS. Report IMS performance to management periodically. Ensure legal, contractual, and organizational compliance within the scope of activities. Identify root causes for non-conformances/deviations and implement corrective/preventive actions. Identify competency gaps for subordinate personnel and implement necessary actions. Carry out annual performance evaluations of reporting employees. Provide on-the-job training to new employees and evaluate their OJT performance. Identify, document, and control hazards in the assigned work area. Ensure identified aspects are monitored and operational controls are followed. Report deviations in the Integrated Management System, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Report emergencies, incidents, and near misses. Ensure effective resource utilization. Perform other duties as assigned by management. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably within a plant maintenance environment. Proficiency in using CMMS (SAP) for work order execution and coordination. Strong understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance principles. Ability to perform technical evaluations and manage procurement processes for spare parts. Work Environment The role involves working in a plant environment where the employee may occasionally encounter moving mechanical parts and varying outside weather conditions. There may be exposure to high precarious places, fumes, airborne particles, toxic chemicals, and electrical shock. The typical noise level is moderate, though very loud conditions can occur.

c5bc365e930f1ede.description: Job description Design and produce visual materials specific to the project, including reports, proposals, and digital brochures, while transforming content and established results into clear and organized designs suitable for governmental entities and stakeholders. Adhere to visual identity guidelines and ensure accurate presentation of information. Responsibilities: Report Design: Prepare and produce regular and final reports, coordinating pages, titles, tables, images, and appendices in a professional manner to facilitate readability. Template Development: Create templates for daily, weekly, and monthly reports, proposals, and brochures, maintaining consistency in outputs and expediting their preparation. Proposal Design: Transform established content into coherent and clear proposals for gatherings and present results and achievements along with work plans. Digital Brochure Design: Prepare posts, advertisements, and promotional and instructional materials specific to the project, ensuring they are tailored to the appropriate usage channels. Infographic Preparation: Convert workflows, metrics, comparisons, and results into visual representations that aid in understanding quickly. Data Presentation Design: Design visual presentations and infographics in coordination with data analysts and performance metrics, while maintaining values, units, and established timelines. Brand Identity Application: Adhere to established colors, fonts, and branding elements, ensuring proper Arabic formatting and text direction from right to left. Coordination with Project Team: Receive content and data from stakeholders, determine design needs and delivery timelines, and track feedback until approval. Quality Review of Outputs: Verify the clarity of texts and figures, the accuracy of page layouts, the quality of images, and the consistency of formatting, ensuring the integrity of files before delivery. File Delivery and Organization: Deliver final copies in appropriate formats for presentation, publication, and distribution, while preserving original files for potential revisions and organizing their versions. Skills Proven experience in designing reports, proposals, and Arabic brochures, with a portfolio to demonstrate this. Proficiency in PowerPoint and relevant design tools such as Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign or equivalents. Ability to organize content and highlight information, simplifying data presentations effectively. Capability to prepare templates that project teams can update. Attention to detail, adherence to deadlines, and ability to absorb feedback and implement it. Commitment to project data integrity and effective use of established materials.

c5fe35ae8f1b31ac.description: About the Future Energy Graduates Internship Program Siemens Energy is offering a Future Energy Graduates Internship Program for individuals seeking to gain professional experience in the energy sector. This internship provides an opportunity to work within an international environment, focusing on solutions related to climate change and energy transformation. The program is available in Dammam and Jeddah, Eastern Region, and is designed for candidates with 0-1 year of experience. Internship Responsibilities Maintain 100% attendance throughout the program, with consideration for emergency and sick leaves. Engage with the high-performance culture and learning opportunities provided. Complete all assigned tasks and duties as required by the program. Adhere to Siemens Energy's internal regulations and guidelines. Professional Development Interns will receive an individual training plan tailored to develop specific skills and knowledge relevant to their role. Upon completion of the program, participants will have acquired knowledge to support their professional career. The internship also offers insight into a multinational work environment and fosters collaboration across various teams and global functions. About Siemens Energy Siemens Energy is an energy technology company that addresses growing energy demand across more than 90 countries while prioritizing climate protection. With over 92,000 employees, the company contributes to generating electricity for over 16% of the global community and utilizes its technology to support environmental protection. The global team is dedicated to advancing sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy solutions, building on a 150-year legacy of innovation focused on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Commitment to Diversity Siemens Energy values diversity and inclusion, recognizing that a workforce composed of over 130 nationalities contributes to its creative energy. The company respects individual character, irrespective of ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. Siemens Energy is committed to equal opportunities and encourages applications from individuals with disabilities.

c546f2f8cb64284d.description: The FP&A Manager for Operating Assets will be responsible for management reporting, budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, analysis, and performance monitoring of some of Qiddiya’s operating assets, including theme parks, hotels, golf courses, and sports venues. This role serves as a bridge between the FP&A department, the Finance Business Partner function, and the Asset Management/Operating Assets teams, working closely with FBPs to provide decision support, performance insights, and strategic financial recommendations. Essential duties and responsibilities: Lead the preparation of budgets, forecasts, and long-term financial plans for operating assets in collaboration with FBPs and Asset Management Support scenario planning for pre-opening, ramp-up, and stabilization phases of assets Track and analyze actual performance against budgets and forecasts, providing variance analysis and actionable insights to FBPs, asset managers, and leadership Develop dashboards and performance reports in collaboration with the FP&A reporting team using tools like Power BI and Anaplan Bachelor's degree in finance or business management. Professional certifications such as CPA, CA, or ACCA are highly recognized. 6+ experience in finance and financial planning & analysis (FP&A) is required, preferably within asset-intensive sectors (such as hospitality, theme parks, sports, or entertainment).

c5560b6430a55923.description: Jasara Program Management Company (Jasara PMC) is a leading Joint Venture between Public Investment Fund (PIF), Jacobs, and Saudi Aramco, established to deliver world-class program management services across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Jasara plays a key role in supporting the realization of Saudi Vision 2030, particularly in delivering giga-projects and large-scale infrastructure developments. We are seeking a Senior Design Manager - MEP (Electrical) to join JASARA PMC. The Senior Design Manager – MEP (Electrical) oversees consultant-led electrical and power system design activities across all project stages, ensuring compliance with requirements, approved design briefs, Scopes of Work (SOW), applicable electrical standards, and authority regulations. The role provides technical leadership and design governance for all electrical engineering disciplines, including power distribution, low voltage (LV) systems, medium voltage (MV) interfaces, substations, switchgear, emergency power systems, ELV integration, and smart city infrastructure. The position ensures electrical designs are coordinated with architectural, structural, mechanical, infrastructure, and specialist disciplines to deliver safe, reliable, efficient, and construction-ready solutions. The Senior Design Manager does not undertake detailed design production but is responsible for reviewing, guiding, and assuring the quality, coordination, compliance, and deliverability of consultant design outputs while supporting the Design Director in technical assurance, cost alignment, value engineering, and delivery readiness. Design Leadership & Governance Oversee, coordinate, and monitor all electrical and power system design activities throughout concept, schematic, detailed design, and construction documentation stages. Lead design governance processes related to electrical engineering, including design reviews, technical compliance reviews, change management, and stage-gate approvals. Ensure all electrical designs comply with standards, Saudi Building Code, SEC requirements, IEC standards, NFPA standards, and applicable international best practices. Establish and maintain electrical design standards, specifications, and technical guidelines across the project portfolio. Consultant Management Manage electrical, MEP, and multidisciplinary consultants, ensuring compliance with approved design briefs, SOWs, project requirements, and quality standards. Review and challenge consultant submissions to ensure optimum technical solutions, operational efficiency, maintainability, and lifecycle value. Monitor consultant performance, deliverable quality, programme adherence, and technical compliance. Participate in consultant selection, technical evaluations, and procurement activities. Electrical Systems Oversight Provide technical oversight for the design and integration of: Medium Voltage (MV) Infrastructure Low Voltage (LV) Distribution Systems LV Switchgear and Main Distribution Boards Substations and Electrical Rooms Emergency and Backup Power Systems UPS Systems Generator Systems Earthing and Lightning Protection External Power Networks Street Lighting Systems Smart City Electrical Infrastructure ELV Interfaces and Building Technologies Multidisciplinary Coordination Act as the primary electrical design interface across all disciplines. Ensure electrical requirements are fully integrated with architectural, structural, mechanical, ICT, security, transportation, and utility infrastructure designs. Lead coordination workshops to identify and resolve design clashes, interface risks, and operational concerns. Ensure electrical systems support overall project functionality, resilience, sustainability, and operational objectives. Technical Assurance & Design Review Review engineering calculations, electrical studies, and design reports including: Load Demand Assessments Load Flow Studies Short Circuit Analysis Protection Coordination Studies Arc Flash Studies Power Quality Assessments Reliability and Redundancy Analysis Verify design compliance, constructability, maintainability, and operational readiness. Ensure design solutions support long-term asset management strategies and operational requirements. Cost, Value Engineering & Risk Management Work closely with Development, Commercial, and Cost Management teams to align electrical designs with approved budgets and project objectives. Lead value engineering reviews without compromising safety, performance, reliability, or operational requirements. Identify technical risks, programme impacts, and cost implications and recommend mitigation measures. Support lifecycle cost assessments and whole-life asset value optimization. Construction & Delivery Support Apply strong construction and execution knowledge to ensure electrical design packages are practical, coordinated, and ready for implementation. Support design-to-construction transitions, technical queries, shop drawing reviews, and site coordination activities. Participate in testing, commissioning, and handover readiness reviews. Support Operational Readiness and Transition (ORT) activities. Minimum 15 years of experience in electrical engineering design and project delivery. Minimum 7 years in senior design management or leadership roles. Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering. Master's Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or Engineering Management preferred. Proven experience managing consultant-led design teams on large-scale mixed-use developments, cities, infrastructure, airports, metros, utilities, theme parks, or giga-projects. Extensive experience with power distribution systems, LV/MV infrastructure, substations, switchgear, and critical electrical systems. Experience in Saudi Arabia or GCC mega-project developments preferred

c5a47cd8e8416bc6.description: We’re looking for a highly technical Dynamics 365 CRM Solution Architect to lead the design and delivery of enterprise customer engagement platforms for large, complex organizations. This is a hands-on, client-facing role for someone who is equally comfortable in a stakeholder workshop and in a technical design review. You’ll understand how the business sells, serves, and engages its customers, shape the target architecture across Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform, and guide delivery teams through to a production-ready, scalable solution. You’ll work on enterprise-scale transformation programmes with multiple workstreams, demanding stakeholders, and real accountability for outcomes. We want someone who brings a point of view, not just someone who executes a specification. You should have shaped solutions, defended architectural decisions, and seen them through go-live. What You'll Do ❏ Lead discovery with business and technology stakeholders to understand objectives, current-state processes, and customer engagement requirements. ❏ Define end-to-end target architectures across Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service, Field Service, and Customer Insights (Data and Journeys). ❏ Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions, balancing configuration, low-code, and custom development. ❏ Make and document key architectural decisions, including fit-gap and out-of-the-box vs. custom approaches, environment strategy, data model design, and the security model. ❏ Design the Dataverse data model, the security architecture (business units, security roles, teams, field-level security), and the approach to data migration from legacy CRM systems. ❏ Design integrations between Dynamics 365 and enterprise platforms such as ERP (including Finance & Operations), marketing, telephony, identity, and data platforms, using Azure Integration Services, APIs, and event-driven patterns. ❏ Define the solution approach across the Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Power Pages, and Copilot Studio. ❏ Provide technical leadership to development teams, including design and code reviews for plugins, PCF controls, and custom workflows, development standards, and ALM through Azure DevOps or Power Platform Pipelines. ❏ Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, security, and data privacy requirements, including regional data residency where applicable. ❏ Contribute to solutioning, estimation, and scoping of new phases and change requests. ❏ Prototype and validate approaches before full implementation to reduce delivery risk. ❏ Identify opportunities to use Copilot and AI capabilities across Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform where they create real business value. ❏ Advise clients on platform roadmap, licensing implications, and adoption best practice. ❏ Produce high-quality architecture artefacts, including solution designs, integration specifications, data models, and technical decision records. ❏ Collaborate with functional consultants, data, integration, and delivery leads throughout discovery, design, build, and optimization. ❏ 10+ years in enterprise technology, including 6+ years architecting on Dynamics 365 CE / CRM. ❏ A track record of leading Dynamics 365 implementations end to end on large-scale, multi-workstream programmes. ❏ Experience in a consulting or systems integration environment, delivering for enterprise clients in a structured, client-facing delivery model. ❏ Deep hands-on expertise in Dynamics 365 and Dataverse, including data modelling, the security model, business process flows, plugins, and the Web API. ❏ Strong working knowledge of the Power Platform and its governance, including environments, DLP policies, and the CoE approach. ❏ Solid integration and Azure skills, including Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, API Management, and Azure Synapse Link / Microsoft Fabric. ❏ Experience leading data migration from legacy CRM platforms (for example, older Dynamics versions or Salesforce). ❏ The ability to communicate architecture clearly to senior business stakeholders and technical teams alike. ❏ Comfort working independently in a contract capacity and getting productive quickly within established client teams. Nice to Have ❏ Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert (PL-600) or Dynamics 365 functional certifications. ❏ Experience with Dynamics 365 Contact Center, Omnichannel, or Field Service at scale. ❏ Experience in regulated or public-sector environments, such as financial services, government, or telecoms. ❏ GCC client experience and/or Arabic language skills.

c5f0498e88fa2af6.description: About the Role SNC-Lavalin Fayez Engineering is seeking a TCC Liaison Officer to ensure seamless coordination between the Transportation Control Centre (TCC) and operational teams during the Operations & Maintenance (O&M) phase of a metro project. This full-time role is critical for maintaining smooth traffic management, timely incident response, and effective communication among all stakeholders involved in metro operations. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Role Purpose and Context The TCC Liaison Officer acts as a primary point of contact, facilitating efficient communication and operational continuity. This role supports the TCC in real-time monitoring, dispatch coordination, and operational decision-making, ensuring that information flows accurately and promptly between control center personnel and field teams. Key Responsibilities Facilitate coordination between the Transportation Control Centre (TCC) and operational teams to ensure efficient traffic management and operational continuity. Act as the primary liaison for incident response, ensuring timely communication and resolution of service disruptions. Support the TCC in real-time monitoring, dispatch coordination, and operational decision-making. Ensure accurate and timely information flow between control center personnel and field teams. Assist in the development and implementation of incident management protocols and response strategies. Collaborate with O&M Contractors, technical teams, and Employer representatives to align operational priorities and ensure compliance with safety and service standards. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Transportation, Traffic Management, or a related discipline. Minimum of 5 years of experience in transportation management systems, preferably within metro or urban rail environments. Experience in metro or railway infrastructure projects. Required Skills Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and coordinate across diverse teams. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of working in high-pressure, real-time operational settings. Familiarity with control center technologies, dispatch systems, and incident tracking tools. Work Environment This role operates within a 24/7 operational environment, requiring flexibility and responsiveness to ensure continuous support for metro operations.

c50a033ade697158.description: About Al Ghurair Al Ghurair is seeking a Financial Services Manager to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on developing and managing the company's automotive financial services ecosystem. Role Overview The Financial Services Manager (FSM) is responsible for driving vehicle sales, increasing finance penetration, and maximizing sales profitability through effective financial solutions. This role involves building and managing strategic partnerships with various financial service providers, negotiating competitive financing programs, and enabling the Sales team. The FSM will also ensure strong controls, compliance, and a positive customer experience, while continuously identifying opportunities to strengthen the company’s financing proposition. The position acts as the commercial link between the Sales Department and external financing partners. Key Responsibilities Support Sales Managers and Sales Consultants with appropriate finance and leasing solutions. Coordinate finance applications with partners and resolve issues affecting approval or vehicle delivery. Monitor key performance indicators including penetration, approval ratio, conversion, turnaround time, and partner service levels. Conduct regular business reviews with financial providers and follow up on agreed actions. Prepare monthly dashboards and forecasts for the EVP. Train the Sales Department on partner products, eligibility criteria, and current campaigns. Ensure all agreements and sales-finance activities comply with approved company governance and applicable requirements. Establish and maintain relationships with decision-makers within banks and finance companies, including relationship managers, credit teams, product heads, and senior management. Manage lender performance. Develop and monitor F&I revenue, track revenue generated through financial arrangements, identify opportunities to increase revenue, and monitor bank commissions. Experience and Qualifications A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience is required for this role. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

c517c6861666824b.description: Job description We are looking for a talented content creator to produce high-quality marketing videos and develop engaging content for platforms like TikTok, Instagram, and Snapchat. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of current trends and the ability to create compelling marketing campaigns that resonate with audiences. Responsibilities include: Producing professional advertising videos and developing creative content. Creating innovative content for social media platforms. Brainstorming trendy ideas and marketing campaigns to attract audiences. Appearing in videos or coordinating appearances as needed. Writing catchy titles and marketing texts suitable for the content. Editing videos and adding audio and visual effects. Monitoring trends and analyzing content performance to continuously improve ideas. Features of the position include: A creative work environment. Opportunities for skill development and marketing experience. Salary based on experience and competence. Skills Experience in content creation and video production. Proficiency in using software like CapCut or Premiere Pro. Creativity and ability to brainstorm new marketing ideas. Familiarity with algorithms and social media platforms. Ability to meet deadlines and work collaboratively within a team. Previous work samples are preferred.

c585f9bb60b18483.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a QA Engineer to join its site-based Construction Supervision team in Riyadh. This full-time position is for a major landmark development project that includes the design, enabling, and main works for a large-scale destination, featuring iconic assets, hospitality facilities, and supporting infrastructure. Project Context The project operates under a client governance framework with stringent requirements for program, quality, safety, and sustainability. The Construction Supervision Consultant (CSC) is responsible for providing independent, end-to-end supervision and management, ensuring all works are completed, integrated, tested, commissioned, and handed over to support successful operations and long-term legacy objectives. Key Responsibilities Implement and maintain the Project Quality Management System (QMS) in accordance with Parsons and client requirements. Monitor construction activities to ensure compliance with approved quality standards, specifications, and procedures. Conduct quality audits, inspections, and surveillance activities across project sites. Review and approve Quality Plans, Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs), method statements, and related quality documentation. Identify, document, and track Non-Conformances (NCRs), Corrective Actions, and Preventive Actions (CAPA). Analyze quality performance trends and recommend continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure effective implementation of QA/QC processes by contractors and subcontractors. Prepare quality reports, audit findings, and performance metrics for project management and clients. Support testing, commissioning, handover, and closeout activities to ensure compliance with quality requirements. Provide quality training, guidance, and technical support to project teams. Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and stakeholders on quality-related matters. Ensure compliance with Parsons quality standards, client requirements, and applicable industry codes and regulations. Mentor and support junior quality personnel as required. Perform other duties related to quality assurance and project delivery as assigned. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction, Project Management, Quality Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Minimum of 10+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, or a related discipline. Desired Skills and Certifications Certified ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, or ability to obtain certification within 6 months of hire. ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), CMQ/OE, or equivalent certification, or ability to obtain within 6 months of hire. Membership in a recognized Quality organization is preferred. Work Location This position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

c5d1f9db28f77884.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة عن كاتب موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم وتنسيق مبادرات التطوير التنظيمي، بما في ذلك الهياكل الوظيفية، إدارة الأداء، والسياسات، بهدف تعزيز فعالية القوى العاملة والكفاءة التشغيلية للشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد ومراجعة وتحديث الهياكل والملفات الوظيفية. دعم تحديد الأهداف والتقييمات ووثائق إدارة الأداء. تطوير ومراجعة سياسات وإجراءات وأدلة الموارد البشرية. تنسيق مبادرات الارتباط الوظيفي والثقافة وإدارة التغيير. حفظ سجلات الهياكل والتقييمات ووثائق التطوير التنظيمي. تنفيذ تحليل الوظائف ودعم تخطيط القوى العاملة والتصميم التنظيمي. تنسيق تحليل الاحتياجات التدريبية ومبادرات التطوير. إعداد التقارير والعروض وتحليل مؤشرات فعالية المنظمة. متابعة إنجاز التقييمات والأنشطة مع المديرين. دعم أطر الكفاءات والمسارات المهنية ومشروعات التحسين ومتابعة تقدمها. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الموارد البشرية أو ما يعادله. القدرة على تنسيق ودعم مبادرات التطوير التنظيمي. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والعروض التقديمية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق الموارد البشرية في شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة، ويقع مقر العمل في مدينة الدمام بالمنطقة الشرقية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق عمل شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المؤهلين لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

c5e4a4b83a714998.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة كارامتارا المتجددة السعودية عن مشرف صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان الالتزام التام بأنظمة ومتطلبات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة (HSE) المعمول بها في المملكة العربية السعودية، وسياسات السلامة الخاصة بالشركة، والمعايير الدولية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تطبيق ومتابعة سياسات وإجراءات وتعليمات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة وفقًا لمعايير الشركة والأنظمة المحلية. ضمان الالتزام بمتطلبات OSHA وISO 45001 ومتطلبات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة الخاصة بالعملاء. إجراء جولات تفتيش يومية في مواقع العمل لتحديد السلوكيات والممارسات غير الآمنة وظروف العمل غير الآمنة. إجراء تقييمات المخاطر وتحليل سلامة المهام (JSA) قبل بدء الأعمال. الإشراف على متطلبات السلامة أثناء أعمال تصنيع الهياكل الفولاذية والجلفنة واللحام والقطع والدهان والتجميع والتحميل وتصنيع أبراج خطوط نقل الكهرباء. متابعة عمليات الرفع باستخدام الرافعات والرافعات الشوكية والمعدات الثقيلة. تنفيذ برامج التوعية والتعريف بمتطلبات السلامة للموظفين والمقاولين الجدد. تقديم اجتماعات السلامة اليومية (Toolbox Talks) وبرامج التوعية بالسلامة بشكل دوري. التحقيق في الحوادث والحوادث الوشيكة وظروف العمل غير الآمنة، وإعداد تقارير التحقيق. تنظيم تدريبات الإخلاء في حالات الطوارئ والتمارين الوهمية، والتنسيق مع فرق الاستجابة للطوارئ. حفظ سجلات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة، وتقارير التفتيش والحوادث، وإعداد التقارير الدورية للإدارة. متابعة مدى التزام المقاولين من الباطن بمتطلبات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة وتقييم أدائهم. فحص معدات وأدوات الرفع والأدوات الكهربائية والمعدات والآلات وأجهزة السلامة. تقديم التوصيات والمقترحات التي تسهم في تعزيز مستوى السلامة في بيئة العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الصحة والسلامة المهنية. معرفة قوية بأنظمة ومتطلبات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة (HSE) في المملكة العربية السعودية. فهم لمتطلبات OSHA وISO 45001. القدرة على إجراء تقييمات المخاطر وتحليل سلامة المهام. مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والتدريب والتوعية بالسلامة. القدرة على التحقيق في الحوادث وإعداد التقارير اللازمة. بيئة العمل يعمل مشرف الصحة والسلامة المهنية بدوام كامل في منشآت تصنيع خطوط نقل الكهرباء ومواقع المشاريع التابعة لشركة كارامتارا المتجددة السعودية في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يهدف الدور إلى توفير بيئة عمل آمنة والحد من الإصابات والحوادث المهنية ومنع وقوعها. التحسين المستمر يساهم شاغل الوظيفة في دعم تطبيق مبادرات السلامة القائمة على السلوك (BBS) ومساعدة الإدارة في تحقيق أهداف ومؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية (KPIs) الخاصة بالصحة والسلامة والبيئة للمشروع. كما يشارك في اجتماعات لجنة الصحة والسلامة والبيئة لتقديم التوصيات والمقترحات التي تعزز مستوى السلامة.

c5e73b281a82ab0d.description: About the Role FNRCO is seeking a Data & AI Platform Section Head to lead the engineering, delivery, and operational management of enterprise data and AI platforms. The role focuses on enabling analytics, AI, and enterprise reporting while ensuring platforms are scalable, reliable, secure, and aligned with digital priorities. Key Responsibilities Translate enterprise data and AI strategies into actionable engineering roadmaps and platform enablement plans, ensuring support for analytics, AI, and enterprise data needs. Lead engineering, deployment, and operational support for data and AI platforms, overseeing provisioning, monitoring, and optimization to ensure reliability, performance, and scalability. Enable advanced analytics, AI, and reporting capabilities by providing high-quality, reliable, and accessible data, and support business teams and data scientists with necessary platforms and tools. Ensure seamless integration of data across applications, platforms, and enterprise systems, managing API/middleware support for data ingestion, transformation, and distribution. Provide regular updates to the Enterprise Platform, Apps & Analytics Manager on roadmap execution, risks, and modernization priorities, applying enterprise standards and best practices. Support monitoring of day-to-day activities to ensure compliance with stipulated policies and procedures, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. Actively participate in on-the-job training, mentoring, and coaching of subordinates, providing clear direction and promoting a high-performance work environment. Platform Strategy and Operations This role is responsible for executing the data and AI platform strategy, ensuring that all platforms meet enterprise standards for security, resilience, and performance. It involves overseeing the entire lifecycle from engineering and deployment to operational support and optimization, critical for business analytics and AI workloads. c5f48959b2d746ae.description: About the Role RAWAJ is seeking a Business Development & Investor Relations Manager for the education sector in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Conduct market research, feasibility studies, financial analysis, and risk assessments to support business and investment decisions. Lead commercial negotiations and coordinate partnership and investment agreements. c5504e1b005fc47d.description: About Alstom and the Role Alstom is a global leader in sustainable and smart mobility, offering a comprehensive portfolio of transport solutions including high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, as well as turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility. This full-time position for an ISR Training Manager is based in Riyadh, where you will contribute to a significant rail project. Role Overview The ISR Training Manager will be responsible for the successful delivery of the ISR training package for the Riyadh Metro Line 2 (Red Line) extension. This role involves close collaboration with various internal and external stakeholders, including the customer, consortium partners, Operations and Maintenance entities, project teams, suppliers, and ISR stakeholders. The manager will oversee the development and execution of training programs, ensuring alignment with project milestones and quality standards. A key focus will be defining the training strategy and managing the Transfer of Technology (ToT) process, alongside coordinating all training activities. Key Responsibilities Define a contract-compliant training strategy that incorporates Transfer of Technology (ToT) requirements. Conduct training needs assessments and develop tailored training plans. Forecast and organize necessary facilities, materials, and digital equipment for training. Coordinate the preparation, production, and distribution of training documents and materials. Evaluate trainees, confirm qualifications, and maintain accurate training records. Build, update, and manage the training schedule. Monitor compliance with contractual, safety, quality, and project requirements. Identify risks and implement mitigation and recovery actions. Track training costs and resource utilization against the approved budget. Collect feedback and analyze training performance to drive continuous improvement. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in training management, ideally within a relevant industry. The role requires expertise in defining training strategies, managing Transfer of Technology processes, and coordinating complex training programs for large-scale projects. Work Environment and Benefits This role offers the opportunity to work within a collaborative and dynamic team environment on an innovative rail project in Riyadh. Alstom provides a flexible and inclusive workplace, with investment in employee development through learning programs. Benefits include a fair and dynamic reward package, comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension), and opportunities for career progression within a global business that values diversity. Application Process Join Alstom in leading greener and smarter mobility worldwide. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

c5d368617e6117e1.description: About PepsiCo PepsiCo is a global leader in beverages and convenient foods, with products enjoyed by consumers over a billion times daily across more than 200 countries. PepsiCo fosters a dynamic and collaborative culture, valuing diversity, equity, and inclusion. The company is committed to creating an environment where all associates have a voice and can thrive. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Ensure line availability and equipment readiness. Follow and review the PepsiCo Maintenance Methodology (PEMM) improvement plan. Perform assigned work orders and other tasks as directed by the supervisor. Solve technical problems, identify necessary actions, and determine parts requirements. Execute maintenance schedules to maintain plant equipment according to engineering standards. Capability to perform electrical and controls works independently. Ability to perform mechanical works independently and provide support. A collaborative team player with effective communication skills. Flexibility in adapting to changes and embracing new ideas. Capable of executing planned activities efficiently. Ability to support and motivate colleagues.

c57efa2afd4aa533.description: About the Role Acwa is seeking an Electrical Supervisor to oversee daily electrical maintenance activities within its plant operations in Makkah, specifically in Rabigh and Makkah. This full-time role focuses on ensuring effective functionality, plant availability, and equipment reliability through diligent supervision of maintenance work. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to supervise all electrical maintenance activities, including preventive and corrective maintenance, planned outages, and overhauling work for electrical equipment. This must be conducted in strict adherence to overall maintenance plans, HSE guidelines, and quality standards. Key Responsibilities Supervise team activities to ensure targets, objectives, and business plans are met in line with established policies and procedures. Allocate resources for scheduled preventative maintenance, breakdowns, and major repair jobs to ensure optimal functionality and timely completion, reporting deviations to the Electrical Engineer. Conduct troubleshooting and root cause analysis for electrical equipment to maintain smooth operations. Test and validate equipment condition post-repair to confirm readiness and compliance with quality standards. Perform regular inspections to monitor work progress of electrical technicians, ensuring adherence to schedules and proper resource allocation, and reporting non-conformances. Participate in investigating and specifying modifications to existing systems, assisting the Electrical Engineer with technical submissions, drawings, and cost estimates. Coordinate the planning and execution of annual outage maintenance for critical electrical equipment, providing technical support to meet EHS, scope, cost, and timeline objectives. Ensure accurate completion of all electrical maintenance documentation, including the Maintenance Log, detailing faults, repair methods, time, labor, and materials. Monitor material and spare parts requirements for electrical maintenance and facilitate procurement to ensure timely availability and replenishment. Adhere to all relevant health, safety, security, and environmental procedures to ensure employee safety and environmental compliance. Comply with all organizational and departmental policies, processes, and standard maintenance procedures. Contribute to the identification and implementation of continuous improvement initiatives. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in electrical maintenance supervision. Demonstrated ability to manage and supervise a team effectively. Strong understanding of preventive and corrective maintenance practices. Proficiency in troubleshooting and root cause analysis for electrical equipment. Knowledge of HSE guidelines and quality standards in an industrial plant setting. Working Relationships The Electrical Supervisor will work closely with the Electrical Engineer, Electrical Technicians, other maintenance teams, and the operations team internally. Externally, the role requires interaction with relevant contractors, SAP, and vendors. Application Information This is a full-time position based in Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c553d2d450896953.description: The Quality Control Engineer is responsible for inspecting, monitoring, and ensuring the quality of all finishing, interior fit-out, natural stone, and marble installation works in accordance with approved shop drawings, project specifications, material submittals, method statements, and applicable quality standards. The role requires strong technical expertise in architectural finishes, high-end interior fit-out, stone and marble fabrication and installation, ensuring that all works meet the required standards of workmanship, dimensional accuracy, alignment, levelness, joint consistency, surface finish, and overall aesthetic quality. The QC Engineer shall coordinate with site engineers, subcontractors, consultants, suppliers, and project management teams to identify quality issues, prevent defects, and ensure that all completed works comply with project requirements before handover. Key Responsibilities 1. Finishing and Interior Fit-Out Quality Control Inspect all architectural finishing and interior fit-out activities, including flooring, wall cladding, ceilings, gypsum works, painting, tiling, joinery, doors, decorative finishes, and other interior works. Ensure all executed works comply with approved shop drawings, technical specifications, material approvals, and project quality requirements. Verify dimensions, levels, alignment, verticality, surface flatness, edge details, and finishing quality. Inspect interfaces between different finishing materials to ensure proper coordination, clean transitions, and high-quality workmanship. Conduct site inspections at each stage of work to identify defects before subsequent activities proceed. 2. Stone and Marble Quality Control Perform detailed inspections of natural stone and marble materials, including marble, granite, limestone, travertine, and other decorative stone finishes. Verify material type, color, veining, texture, thickness, dimensions, finish, and overall consistency against approved samples and material submittals. Inspect stone and marble slabs, tiles, and fabricated pieces for cracks, chips, scratches, stains, discoloration, edge damage, and other visual or dimensional defects. Verify slab selection, vein matching, bookmatching, grain direction, color consistency, and layout patterns in accordance with approved drawings and samples. Inspect stone fabrication, cutting, edge profiling, mitre joints, corner details, openings, cut-outs, and polishing quality. Monitor stone and marble installation, ensuring correct setting-out, alignment, levelness, joint width, lippage control, fixing systems, adhesive application, and anchoring methods. Verify substrate preparation, waterproofing where applicable, backing supports, mechanical fixing systems, and installation methods according to approved details and manufacturer recommendations. Inspect grouting, joint filling, sealant application, staining protection, cleaning, polishing, and final finishing. Ensure proper handling, transportation, storage, and protection of stone and marble materials to prevent damage before and after installation. Identify and report unacceptable workmanship, material defects, and installation deviations, and ensure corrective actions are completed. 3. Inspection and Quality Documentation Prepare and submit Inspection Requests (IRs/WIRs) and coordinate inspections with the consultant and client representatives. Review approved shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and project specifications before work execution. Maintain inspection records, checklists, material inspection reports, non-conformance reports (NCRs), and quality documentation. Raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) for defective or non-compliant works and follow up on corrective and preventive actions. Verify that corrective works have been completed satisfactorily before requesting reinspection. Maintain photographic records of site inspections, defects, corrective actions, and completed works. Support the preparation of snag lists, de-snagging inspections, and final handover documentation. 4. Site Coordination and Quality Assurance Coordinate with site engineers, finishing engineers, subcontractors, stone suppliers, fabrication workshops, consultants, and project management teams. Review and inspect mock-ups and sample installations before approving or recommending approval for mass production and installation. Monitor workmanship during execution and provide technical guidance to prevent recurring quality defects. Ensure materials and workmanship are consistent with approved samples, design intent, project specifications, and client expectations. Participate in quality meetings, progress inspections, and technical coordination meetings. Ensure completed works are properly protected against damage caused by subsequent construction activities. Monitor compliance with approved quality procedures, relevant standards, and project-specific requirements. 5. Final Inspection and Handover Conduct final quality inspections of completed finishing, fit-out, stone, and marble works. Verify uniformity of finishes, joint consistency, alignment, surface condition, cleanliness, and overall visual appearance. Identify and document defects, incomplete works, and deviations from approved requirements. Follow up on snagging and de-snagging activities until all quality issues are resolved. Ensure proper cleaning, sealing, polishing, protection, and maintenance requirements are completed before handover. Assist in compiling quality records and handover documents. Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architectural Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in construction quality control, preferably in finishing, interior fit-out, and high-end architectural projects. Strong hands-on experience in natural stone and marble fabrication, installation, inspection, and finishing. Practical knowledge of marble and stone flooring, wall cladding, countertops, staircases, vanity tops, decorative stone features, and custom stonework. Good understanding of architectural drawings, shop drawings, material specifications, method statements, and installation details. Experience in preparing inspection requests, quality checklists, NCRs, and inspection reports. Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality management principles and project-specific QA/QC procedures. Proficiency in reading construction drawings and using AutoCAD and Microsoft Office is preferred. Strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and reporting skills. A

c5c330e0341c9be5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سراكو عن فني أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في العيون، القصيم. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب ومراقبة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بالإضافة إلى دعم مهندسي الإلكترونيات في أنشطة البحث والتطوير. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب ومراقبة الأجهزة الإلكترونية والمعدات، بما في ذلك الدوائر وعناصر التحكم والآلات. دراسة المخططات الفنية لتحديد نوع وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والميكانيكيين وغيرهم من الحرفيين أثناء عمليات تركيب الأجهزة الإلكترونية. إجراء اختبارات شاملة للأجهزة الإلكترونية بعد التركيب لضمان مطابقتها للمخططات والمواصفات. تنفيذ عمليات الفحص الروتينية للصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص التلفيات والأعطال المحتملة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. تقديم المساعدة التقنية لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في جهود البحث والتطوير المتعلقة بالأجهزة الإلكترونية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال فنيي الأجهزة الإلكترونية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية والرسومات الهندسية. معرفة قوية بمكونات الأجهزة الإلكترونية وطرق تركيبها وصيانتها. مهارات تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها بكفاءة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة سراكو في مدينة العيون بمنطقة القصيم. سيعمل الفني بشكل وثيق مع مهندسي الإلكترونيات وغيرهم من المتخصصين لضمان الأداء الأمثل للمعدات. المهارات الشخصية الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في جميع مهام التركيب والصيانة. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتنسيق مع الزملاء. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات الفنية. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم.

c5fcb956b23a9add.description: موظفة خدمة عملاء وكول سنتر فرصة وظيفية للسعوديات في الرياض – حي العليا نعلن عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى موظفة خدمة عملاء ومركز اتصال (Call Center)، للعمل حضوريًا في حي العليا بمدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق عمل احترافي ومميز. تفاصيل الوظيفة * المسمى الوظيفي: موظفة خدمة عملاء وكول سنتر. * الجنسية: سعودية فقط. * موقع العمل: الرياض – حي العليا. * نوع العمل: حضوري. * الدوام: صباحي. * الراتب الأساسي. * المزايا المالية: عمولات وحوافز إضافية مقابل المواعيد المؤكدة، وفق آلية الاستحقاق المعتمدة لدى الشركة. المهام والمسؤوليات: التواصل مع العملاء هاتفيًا وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة عن خدمات الشركة. تحديد المواعيد مع العملاء ومتابعتها والتأكد من تأكيدها. متابعة العملاء وتحديث بياناتهم وتوثيق المواعيد في النظام المعتمد. الرد على استفسارات العملاء والتعامل مع طلباتهم باحترافية. الالتزام بجودة التواصل وتحقيق الأهداف المطلوبة. المساهمة في رفع نسبة المواعيد المؤكدة وتحقيق مؤشرات الأداء المستهدفة. Requirements أن تكون المتقدمة سعودية الجنسية. وجود خبرة سابقة في خدمة العملاء أو الكول سنتر أو التنسيق الهاتفي للمواعيد. مهارات تواصل وإقناع ممتازة ولباقة في الحديث. القدرة على متابعة العملاء وتحويل الاستفسارات إلى مواعيد مؤكدة. إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي وتسجيل البيانات. الالتزام والانضباط والقدرة على تحقيق الأهداف.

c5cf96f20af151ea.description: About the Role eSense is seeking a Senior Consultant to lead and deliver consulting workstreams for clients across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This full-time role, based in Riyadh, involves aligning proposed solutions with Saudi Vision 2030, national and sectoral strategies, and regulatory requirements. The Senior Consultant will operate within engagement scopes under the supervision of a Project Manager or Engagement Lead, guiding and reviewing the work of other consultants and analysts. Key Responsibilities Study client mandates and strategic directions, analyzing linkages to Vision 2030 targets, Vision Realization Programs (VRPs), and sectoral strategies to determine implications for project deliverables. Conduct current-state diagnoses and maturity assessments through institutional document analysis, data review, interviews, workshops, and evidence collection. Identify gaps, root causes, and remediation priorities based on impact and feasibility. Develop strategic plans by analyzing internal and external environments and stakeholder requirements, defining vision, mission, objectives, priorities, initiatives, and success measures aligned with client mandates and national directions. Translate strategy to execution by cascading objectives to organizational units and operational plans, defining initiatives, activities, responsibilities, deliverables, timelines, and required resources. Support periodic plan reviews and updates. Design target operating models across services, value chains, capabilities, organization, governance, processes, resources, data, technology, and performance, with clear design rationale and activation requirements. Develop organizational structures, unit mandates, roles, RACI matrices, delegation of authority, and decision-making/escalation mechanisms to clarify accountability and integration. Inventory and classify services, develop service catalogs and service cards, define beneficiaries, service owners, eligibility requirements, delivery channels, and target service levels. Analyze beneficiary journeys and improvement opportunities. Build integrated, multi-level process architectures guided by the APQC Process Classification Framework (PCF), tailored to client businesses and linked to services and organizational units. Analyze end-to-end processes, identify duplication, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities, redesign processes, and document procedures including inputs, outputs, roles, controls, forms, and integration points. Develop frameworks, methodologies, and practices for institutional excellence, continuous improvement, and knowledge management. Conduct assessments against adopted excellence models and convert results into improvement plans. Design cascaded strategic and operational KPIs at entity, unit, service, and process levels. Develop KPI cards defining formulas, data sources, owners, measurement frequency, baselines, and targets in coordination with stakeholders. Validate measurement data quality, prepare performance reports and dashboards, analyze results, variances, and root causes, recommend and track corrective actions, and use results to refine plans, services, and processes. Develop activation roadmaps covering priorities, dependencies, responsibilities, change requirements, and risks. Support piloting, train client teams, transfer knowledge, and address implementation feedback. Plan and track tasks within approved schedules and effort, guide consultants and analysts, review their outputs, facilitate technical meetings and workshops, document decisions, and report progress, risks, and change requests to the Project Manager. Develop reusable consulting tools, templates, and methodologies, document lessons learned, support colleague development, and contribute to technical proposals and the estimation of scope, effort, and deliverables. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in consulting or a related field. The role requires a strong understanding of strategic planning, operating model design, organizational structures, and performance management frameworks. Experience with Saudi Vision 2030 and national strategies is essential. Required Skills Ability to diagnose current-state maturity and develop strategic and operational plans. Proficiency in designing target operating models, organizational structures, and governance frameworks. Skills in building service catalogs and process architectures. Competence in designing performance measurement frameworks and KPIs. Strong leadership capabilities to guide and review the work of junior consultants and analysts. Excellent communication and presentation skills for client engagement and workshop facilitation. Ability to contribute to proposals and firm consulting methodologies. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working with diverse clients across the Kingdom, requiring an understanding of national and institutional contexts. Application Process eSense invites qualified candidates to apply for this Senior Consultant position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c5e4dcc185f01f97.description: About the Role Astek Middle East is seeking an experienced Digital Marketing & Digital Channels Expert to manage digital marketing operations and optimize digital channels for a leading organization in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. c5bcbbf7ac13de77.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ديجيتوس كونيكت عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، وإعداد برامج الصيانة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات خطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وتحديد مساراتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية، ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية. معرفة ببرامج تشغيل المعدات والأنظمة الكهربائية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية، في بيئة عمل بدوام كامل تهدف إلى تحقيق الأهداف الهندسية للمشاريع المختلفة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قوية في إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الفنية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وإعداد التقارير الفنية المتخصصة. مهارات متابعة التنفيذ والصيانة الوقائية. القدرة على تطوير أساليب العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة ديجيتوس كونيكت في هذا الدور، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

c5fbe3bbb749424a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن فني صيانة مبانٍ للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة خطط الصيانة الدورية للمباني، وتحديد المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة. يشمل الدور أيضاً قياس الأعمال المنجزة وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، بالإضافة إلى إعداد المطالبات المالية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة تفاصيل خطة الصيانة الدورية لمختلف الأبنية، وتحديد العيوب الفنية، ومناقشة طرق معالجتها مع المهندس المختص. إعداد قائمة بالمواد اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال الصيانة المختلفة، وتحديد الأدوات والمعدات والعمال المطلوبين لإنجاز العمل. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال الصيانة الدورية والطارئة، والتحقق من مطابقة الأعمال المنفذة للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. إدارة وتوجيه فرق العمل، وتوزيع المهام اليومية على الفنيين بناءً على مؤهلاتهم وقدراتهم. تطبيق المواصفات الفنية وضمان تنفيذ جميع الأعمال وفقاً للرسومات الهندسية ومواصفات إجراءات العمل المعتمدة. توضيح تفاصيل المخططات للمرؤوسين، ومتابعة دوام فرق العمل، ورفع تقارير دورية بشأن الأعمال المنجزة. قياس الأعمال المنجزة، وحساب كمياتها وتدقيقها، وإعداد المطالبات المالية بالتنسيق مع محاسب الكميات، وتسليم الأعمال لجهة الإشراف. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال صيانة المباني. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والرسومات الهندسية. معرفة جيدة بمواد وأدوات ومعدات الصيانة المختلفة. مهارات إشرافية وقيادية لإدارة فرق العمل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يعمل فني صيانة المباني ضمن فريق متخصص يساهم في الحفاظ على جودة وكفاءة الأبنية. المزايا يتم تحديد الراتب والمزايا الأخرى بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم مناقشتها خلال عملية المقابلة. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر القنوات المتاحة.

c546426814c45eba.description: We are seeking an experienced Document Controller to manage project documentation, ensure accurate document distribution and tracking, and maintain organized electronic and physical records in accordance with project requirements. Key Responsibilities Manage, control, and maintain project documents using Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS). Ensure proper document numbering, filing, revision control, and distribution. Maintain organized folder structures and electronic document databases. Monitor document status and ensure timely submission, review, and approval. Perform PDF management and ensure document quality and accuracy. Coordinate with project teams, contractors, and stakeholders regarding documentation. Prepare reports and maintain accurate document control records. Ensure compliance with project document control procedures and requirements. Requirements Associate Degree in Technical Engineering Technology or related field. Minimum 7 years of relevant Document Control experience . Proficiency in EDMS platforms such as SharePoint, Documentum , or similar systems. Strong IT skills with MS Office, including Word, Excel, and Outlook . Excellent communication and proficient typing skills. Strong attention to detail, analytical, organizational, and time-management skills. Ability to meet deadlines and work effectively as part of a team. Preferred Certifications Certified Document Controller (CDC) or equivalent. Records Management / Information Management or equivalent certification.

c527b3eefbc5ad76.description: About Noon Noon is a leading consumer commerce platform in the region, established in Saudi Arabia and the UAE in December 2017, and expanding to Egypt in February 2019. The Noon ecosystem includes marketplaces for food delivery, quick commerce, fintech, and fashion. The company is currently in a growth phase, with six years of operation and ongoing development. The Role Noon is seeking an Information Technology Support Technician to join its team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves working closely with business units, fellow technicians, and engineering teams to implement, maintain, and support critical IT infrastructure. The technician will also provide daily technical support to meet current and future business requirements. The ideal candidate will have 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Provide 1st and 2nd line support to ensure optimal performance of IT equipment and infrastructure, meeting departmental KPIs and SLAs on site. Participate in site-wide projects that address evolving business and IT needs. Install, maintain, and support IT equipment, including laptops, telecoms equipment, printers, scanners, thin clients, and workstations. This may also involve cabling work after training. Manage the imaging of workstations and laptops, including updates. Offer technical support and input for site and team projects and initiatives. Undertake ad-hoc requests and tasks as required. Manage IT assets and inventory, including checks and audits in line with global standards and processes, and handle Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) processes with suppliers. Required Qualifications and Skills Experience in MS Windows System Support. Some experience with Linux/Unix System Support. Two years of prior technical (IT) exposure or experience, preferably in an operational environment, is highly favorable. Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey technical information to non-technical audiences. A strong commitment to customer service and a demonstrated history of excellent customer-facing skills. Demonstrable methodical problem-solving and strong analytical skills. Ability to keep others informed of information that contributes to team, department, or company performance. An excellent understanding of computer hardware and software, coupled with a willingness to learn new technology and acquire new skills. Candidate Profile Noon seeks individuals who uphold high standards and recognize the importance of diligent work. Candidates should be resourceful, possess a strong bias for action, and demonstrate originality. The environment at Noon requires adaptability, flexibility, and a continuous learning mindset.

c54144d1efa1b60c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ابو عزام للتطوير والإستثمارات العقارية عن وسيط عقاري للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى مساعدة البائعين والمشترين في إتمام الصفقات العقارية، وتقديم الاستشارات اللازمة لترويج العقارات بفعالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية مساعدة البائعين في ترويج عقاراتهم لجذب العروض والإعلان عنها. التوسط في التعاملات بين البائعين والمشترين لضمان إتمام الصفقات. تقييم رغبات العملاء والميزانيات المحددة والقدرات الاقتصادية، وتقديم الاقتراحات المناسبة لهم. استكمال الوثائق والمستندات القانونية اللازمة لإجراء التعاقدات والاتفاقيات. الإشراف وإدارة التوكيلات العقارية. تقييم قيمة العقارات من خلال إجراء بحث شامل في السوق. التعاون والتواصل مع العملاء والمقاولين والمحامين وأصحاب العقارات. تقديم معلومات دقيقة بشأن القواعد القانونية، الأسعار، المواصفات، وتوافر الممتلكات. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الوساطة العقارية أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد لآليات السوق العقاري في مكة المكرمة. القدرة على التعامل مع الوثائق القانونية والعقود. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات تواصل ممتازة ولباقة في التعامل مع العملاء والشركاء. قدرة على التفاوض وإبرام الصفقات بنجاح. مهارات بحث وتحليل السوق لتقييم العقارات. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق. بيئة العمل يعمل الوسيط العقاري بدوام كامل في مكة المكرمة، ضمن فريق شركة ابو عزام للتطوير والإستثمارات العقارية. يتطلب الدور التفاعل المستمر مع العملاء والجهات المعنية في السوق العقاري. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال المقابلة الشخصية.

c565517da2e0e4b2.description: About the Role Hill International, Inc. is seeking a Testing & Commissioning Section Head to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position requires a professional with extensive experience in managing testing and commissioning activities for large-scale projects, ensuring compliance with project standards and client requirements. Key Responsibilities Manage the integration and validation activities of contractors, including the validation of all Test and Commissioning plans and procedures. Lead, direct, and supervise a team of discipline engineers in the preparation and execution of commissioning work. Assume responsibility for the completion of implementation in conformance with client needs and project standards. Plan, organize, and supervise works to ensure all activities are performed within the project schedule parameters. Liaise with the Systems Engineering team for engineering support and control. Coordinate with the Operator, Civil Defense, EXPRO, and other third parties regarding all necessary testing and commissioning requirements. Ensure all testing and commissioning works are comprehensive and discussed with stakeholders for optimal implementation. Approve testing and commissioning works. Participate in negotiations with regulatory agencies in public meetings with the client. Initiate risk assessments for testing and commissioning works, review and endorse results, and recommend mitigation actions. Attend final inspections on completed projects and initiate Contract Completion Certificates and Handover Certificates. Coordinate all activities for successful project commissioning within schedules and contractual requirements, overseeing coordination between all relevant parties. Review calibration of testing equipment on site. Review testing and commissioning plans submitted by contractors to ensure compliance with operational requirements. Write Testing & Commissioning reports and documentation. Ensure completion of training for maintenance and operative staff, O&M manuals, spare parts, and as-built drawings. Maintain compliance with Hill International's Quality, Environmental, Safety, and Occupational Health Policies, Manuals, and Procedures. Perform other duties as assigned by the line manager/supervisor. Qualifications and Experience A degree in engineering or a scientific discipline. Minimum of 20 years of experience in large-scale projects, including prior experience as a testing and commissioning manager. Knowledge of all phases of construction operations related to field activities of engineering disciplines, construction technologies, and jobsite management. Experience in implementing a zero-accident philosophy. Extensive knowledge of health, safety, and environmental policies, processes, and procedures. Knowledge of Project Construction Environmental Control Plans. Excellent knowledge of Water and Wastewater works. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and operates on a full-time basis within a dynamic project environment. The successful candidate will work collaboratively with various internal and external stakeholders to ensure project success.

c58eb0a2ac0c9589.description: About the Role SFC is seeking a Modern Trade Key Account Officer to join their team in the Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on managing key accounts within modern trade channels, ensuring the achievement of sales and collection targets. The position is open to candidates with 0-1 years of experience in a relevant field. Role Overview The Modern Trade Key Account Officer is responsible for driving key performance indicators, including volume, visibility, and collection, across assigned accounts. This involves strategic planning, execution of commercial activities, and close collaboration with various departments to ensure operational efficiency and financial compliance. Key Responsibilities Achieve annual and monthly sales targets set by the head office. Ensure the execution of all planned activities and contractual agreements (BDAs) for managed accounts. Monitor and ensure compliance with all financial aspects of the account to maximize return on investment through correct execution of commercial plans and financial policies. Contribute to the development of the company's overall sales strategy. Meet monthly collection targets from managed accounts, aiming for 100% settlement. Plan activities at least 8 weeks in advance, providing all necessary supporting documentation for full programming and reporting. Plan appropriate customer service levels, including sales calls, activities, product displays, and logistics, by collaborating closely with different departments. Prepare accurate and timely reports, ensuring alignment with company policies and requirements. Required Experience 0-1 years of professional experience in a relevant field. Work Location This position is based in the Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia, covering cities such as Dammam, Al Khobar, Dhahran, Al Jubail, Al-Ahsa, Al Qatif, Ras Tannurah, Al Khafji, Buqayq, Al Hafuf, Al Mubarraz, Safwa, Sayhat, Tarut, Inak, Darin, and Umm Al Hamam. Application Process Candidates who meet the above requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c5b26d53076b8623.description: About Nestlé Professional Nestlé is recognized as the world's largest food and beverage company. At its core, Nestlé operates as a human-centric environment, driven by individuals passionate about enhancing the quality of life and contributing to a healthier future. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Role Overview The Assistant Manager, Key Account Management, is responsible for achieving sales targets across various categories. This involves maximizing both short-term and long-term growth opportunities while building and maintaining strong, enduring relationships with customers. The role requires 2-5 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Achieve area sales growth targets by category. Ensure core distribution, including listing new Stock Keeping Units (SKUs), meeting picture of success targets, and adhering to agreed visibility and other Business Development Agreement (BDA) elements. Develop strong customer relationships and initiate contract negotiations regarding visibility, promotions, and implementations. Conduct daily field visits and follow up with B2B Channel partners in the assigned area to ensure product availability. Report market intelligence, including sales analysis, monthly initiative implementations, competitor activities, launches, customer plans, and shopper profiles, to sales management. Ensure effective and efficient implementation of promotional plans in outlets within the assigned area(s). Confirm product availability based on core distribution by communicating with the cash van team and following up on customer visits. Ensure collections and financial reconciliations are completed in line with Nestlé's payment terms. Follow up with the cash van team on their daily journey plans, resolve any issues, and provide constructive feedback on stock handling and product implementation. Compliance and Ethical Standards The role requires strict adherence and compliance with all activities, including those taking place on trade, to the WHO International Code of Marketing of Breast-Milk Substitutes and Nestlé Instructions, as well as local country codes. Compliance with Nestlé’s stringent requirements means that marketing and sales personnel will not seek contact with, or provide advice to, pregnant women or mothers of infants and young children regarding Infant Formula in their business capacity. Experience Required Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience for this position.
