c5f448d4de4ddc51.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مصنع الزيت الطبيعي للتعبئة والتغليف عن فني جودة للانضمام إلى فريقه في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على ضمان جودة المنتجات من خلال الفحص والتحليل المستمر، والمساهمة في تطوير وتحسين سياسات وإجراءات الجودة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية جمع عينات المنتجات من مختلف مراحل عملية التصنيع، بما في ذلك المنتجات قيد التصنيع والمنتجات النهائية. إجراء الفحوصات والتحليلات اللازمة لعينات المنتجات، والتحقق من مطابقتها لمعايير الجودة المحددة. توثيق نتائج الفحوصات والتحليلات بشكل دقيق ومنظم. تحديد مصادر العيوب المحتملة في المنتجات أو العمليات، وتقديم توصيات فعالة للتخفيف من آثارها. مراجعة وتحديث سياسات وإجراءات الجودة بشكل دوري لضمان فعاليتها ومواكبتها لأفضل الممارسات. مراقبة تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الجودة في جميع مراحل الإنتاج. الحفاظ على المعرفة الفنية وتحديثها باستمرار فيما يتعلق باتجاهات القطاع واللوائح الحكومية ذات الصلة بالجودة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال مراقبة الجودة أو دور مماثل. القدرة على جمع العينات وإجراء الفحوصات والتحليلات بدقة. فهم جيد لمعايير الجودة وإجراءات التحكم بها. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مصنع الزيت الطبيعي للتعبئة والتغليف بالمدينة المنورة، ويتطلب التواجد في الموقع للمشاركة في عمليات فحص الجودة اليومية. عن مصنع الزيت الطبيعي للتعبئة والتغليف مصنع الزيت الطبيعي للتعبئة والتغليف هو منشأة متخصصة في إنتاج وتعبئة المنتجات، ملتزمة بتقديم منتجات عالية الجودة لعملائها. يقع المصنع في المدينة المنورة، ويسعى باستمرار لتعزيز معايير الجودة في جميع عملياته. التقديم إذا كنت تمتلك الخبرة والمؤهلات المطلوبة وتتطلع إلى الانضمام إلى فريق عمل ملتزم بالجودة، ندعوك للتقديم على هذا الدور.

c51f413cff00dc53.description: About the Role Future Pipe Industries is seeking a Regional Quality Manager to join their team in Dammam, Eastern region. This full-time role involves leading and governing the implementation of the Group Quality framework across all operating plants and central functions. The successful candidate will drive systemic quality improvements, ensure standardization of QMS practices across regions, and strengthen audit governance, certification readiness, and risk mitigation at an enterprise level. The Regional Quality Manager will also act as the second-in-command to the Senior Manager – Quality and deputize when required. Key Responsibilities Translate Group Quality strategy into actionable regional deployment plans and drive standardization of QMS implementation across all plants. Lead cross-functional quality initiatives aligned with operational and commercial objectives, identifying systemic risks impacting product certification, compliance, and customer acceptance. Develop annual audit plans ensuring structured coverage of all plants and functions, leading complex cross-site audits and high-risk investigations. Review audit findings across plants, ensuring uniform corrective action implementation and establishing centralized tracking of NCR trends and systemic quality gaps. Support preparation and readiness for third-party audits and surveillance visits, conducting gap analysis against international standards and regulatory requirements. Ensure updates to changing national/international standards are implemented group-wide and liaise with certification bodies, inspection authorities, and external auditors as required. Lead Lean Six Sigma–based quality improvement programs, driving reduction in defect rates, repair rates, rejection rates, and improving First Pass Yield. Standardize root cause methodologies across plants and benchmark performance to replicate best practices across regions. Oversee high-impact customer complaints and product failures, reviewing root cause quality and corrective action robustness. Ensure lessons learned are institutionalized across all manufacturing locations and present complaint trends and systemic risks to senior management. Establish group-level dashboards for defect trends, NCR trends, audit findings, customer satisfaction, and site failure data. Provide consolidated quality performance reports to the Senior Manager and VP as required, identifying predictive indicators to prevent recurring quality issues. Review and improve the Group Quality Manual and procedures, driving harmonization of documentation practices across regions. Ensure calibration, testing protocols, and qualification testing compliance, and introduce digitalization initiatives within Quality systems where feasible. Coach plant quality managers and engineers, design structured QMS capability frameworks across plants, and drive Quality awareness programs and cultural transformation initiatives. Prepare and manage the Quality training budget. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of relevant experience in quality management. Demonstrated ability to lead and govern quality frameworks across multiple operating plants and central functions. Proven experience in driving systemic quality improvements and standardizing QMS practices. Strong background in audit governance, certification readiness, and risk mitigation at an enterprise level. Experience with Lean Six Sigma–based quality improvement programs. Internal and External Communication This role requires extensive communication with various internal and external stakeholders. Internally, the Regional Quality Manager will interact with the VP – Quality, Senior Manager – Quality, Operations Heads, BU Managers, Plant Managers, HSE, P&C, and Procurement. Externally, communication will involve certification bodies, regulatory authorities, third-party inspection agencies, and strategic customers (as delegated).

c531f88999ba34da.description: About the Role ArcelorMittal Tubular Products Al-Jubail is seeking an Accountant, Accounts Receivable to join their team in Al Jubail. Maintain accounts receivable records to ensure current aging, proper application of credits and collections, accounting for uncollectible amounts, and reconciliation of miscellaneous differences. Manage and initiate accounts closure procedures in coordination with other sections to ensure timely account finalization. Ensure timely follow-up on all collection efforts. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 3-5 years of relevant experience in accounts receivable or a similar accounting role. A strong understanding of accounting principles and practices is essential for this position. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Jubail, requiring a commitment to maintaining high standards of accuracy and efficiency in a dynamic financial environment. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c537bbc4304776d8.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن فني هندسة كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، عسير. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تركيب وصيانة الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية، وتقديم الدعم الفني للمهندسين. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب المحركات واللوحات والمولدات والمحولات الكهربائية، والإشراف عليها ومراقبتها. تقديم المساعدة للمهندسين الكهربائيين في تشخيص وحل المشكلات الفنية. تحديد المخططات وتقدير كميات المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة المطلوبة بناءً على المخططات الأولية. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والفنيين والحرفيين الآخرين فيما يتعلق بأعمال التركيب الكهربائي. اختبار الأنظمة بعد التركيب لضمان مطابقتها للمخططات الأولية والمواصفات المطلوبة. إجراء عمليات الفحص الروتينية ضمن الصيانة الوقائية، وتشخيص الأعطال والتلف المحتمل، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. التحقق من الأعطال وفحص الأجزاء والمعدات التالفة، وتشخيص المكونات المعطوبة وإصلاحها أو استبدالها. ضمان الاستجابة السريعة لعمليات الطوارئ للتقليل من فترات انقطاع التيار الكهربائي. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الكهربائية والمواصفات الفنية. معرفة قوية بمبادئ التركيب والصيانة والاختبار للأنظمة الكهربائية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في حل المشكلات والتشخيص الفني. القدرة على العمل بفعالية ضمن فريق وتوجيه العمال. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة والجودة في جميع الأعمال. بيئة العمل يعمل شاغل الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة أبها بمنطقة عسير، ضمن بيئة تتطلب الدقة والالتزام بالجودة في تنفيذ المهام الكهربائية. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذا الدور في شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل.

c58502dc9d142147.description: About the Role Bupa Arabia is seeking a Senior Registrar Endocrinology to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves providing comprehensive medical care to adult patients in both physical and telemedicine settings, addressing all internal medicine and endocrinology needs. The Senior Registrar will be responsible for delivering expert clinical care in the diagnosis, treatment, and management of various endocrine conditions, collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to ensure optimal patient outcomes. Key Responsibilities Conduct comprehensive assessments and accurate diagnoses of endocrine disorders, including detailed patient histories and physical examinations. Utilize diagnostic tools such as blood tests, imaging studies (ultrasound, MRI), and other endocrine function tests, collaborating with laboratory staff for interpretation. Perform comprehensive telehealth consultations for internal and general medicine complaints. Develop personalized treatment plans, prescribe medications, and provide ongoing patient education for conditions like diabetes, thyroid disorders, adrenal diseases, and metabolic syndromes. Oversee ongoing care for chronic and acute conditions, adjusting treatment plans based on patient feedback and clinical outcomes. Practice population health management by identifying and addressing community health issues, implementing preventive measures, and promoting health education. Document findings and treatment plans meticulously in patient records. Ensure the delivery of high-quality and safe clinical care, adhering to established clinical guidelines and best practices. Participate in quality assurance initiatives, including audits and peer reviews, and implement safety protocols to minimize risks. Collaboration and Patient Care Foster effective collaboration with multidisciplinary healthcare teams, including primary care physicians, specialists, and nurses, to ensure seamless patient care. Engage in regular case discussions and attend departmental meetings to contribute to the development of clinical pathways and treatment protocols. Facilitate referrals to and from other specialties based on patient needs and complex cases. Maintain compliance with all patient safety standards, reporting any risks or issues to the quality department. Ensure patient satisfaction through clear communication, complete history taking, empathy, and thorough explanation of diagnoses and management plans. Professional Development and Compliance Commit to ongoing professional development by participating in continuing medical education (CME) activities, workshops, and conferences. Stay updated on advancements in endocrinology practices and technologies. Ensure compliance with health regulations and institutional policies. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in endocrinology. The role requires a strong background in providing comprehensive medical care and managing a wide range of endocrine conditions, along with a focus on population health management and value-based care. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a multidisciplinary team environment, focusing on efficient and effective healthcare delivery to optimize resources and enhance patient outcomes.

c589cf2011d9cece.description: Role Summary The Quality Inspector – Electrical is responsible for monitoring and ensuring all electrical installations and testing activities comply with approved project specifications, electrical codes, quality procedures, and inspection requirements. The role involves daily site inspections, identifying non-conformances, reviewing contractor submissions, and ensuring that all electrical works meet the project's quality objectives. The inspector works closely with the QC Manager, electrical engineers, and contractors to maintain high-quality execution across all electrical systems. Key Responsibilities Conduct daily site surveillances to ensure electrical works are progressing according to approved ITPs, checklists, and specifications. Identify deficiencies, faults, and non-compliance issues related to electrical works and report them immediately to the QC Manager for corrective action. Close all electrical WIRs and MIRs after verifying that all required documentation and approvals from relevant discipline engineers are complete. Review and understand electrical specifications, drawings, PQP, ITPs, method statements, QC procedures, and other related quality documents. Witness testing and inspection of electrical systems and materials (e.g., cables, switchgear, grounding, conduits, panels) and complete associated forms per approved procedures. Monitor and review contractor practices related to electrical quality and safety to ensure compliance with project requirements. Conduct daily coordination meetings with the contractor’s QC representative to ensure full understanding of electrical quality management procedures. Assist the construction team with resolving electrical quality issues and technical challenges. Support the Quality Manager (QM) in preparing and executing quality audits related to electrical work. Prepare daily QC reports and submit them to the QC Manager no later than 9:00 AM the following day. Verify that all electrical testing tools and measuring devices have valid calibration certificates. Review and maintain logs of electrical WIRs, MIRs, MARs, NCRs, and other quality documentation. Report any discipline-related miscoordination affecting electrical systems to the Resident Engineer (RE) and Quality Manager (QM). Qualifications & Requirements 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably within a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) environment. Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering or a related field. Strong understanding of electrical systems, installations, testing, and commissioning. Familiarity with international electrical codes and standards. Excellent attention to detail with strong documentation and reporting skills. Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, technical specifications, and method statements. Strong communication skills and a proactive approach to resolving quality issues.
